info.title: Kalpa API
info.description: Demand & Inventory Intelligence platform API. Auth: HttpOnly cookie JWT + X-CSRF-Token header.

get.description: Report API version, git SHA and DB / Redis / worker status.
Latency percentiles, throughput, error rate, queue depth, DB size, cache hit rate and versions (live values).

post.description: Create a user + organisation (caller becomes owner) and start a session.
Verify credentials (rate-limited per IP+email) and start a session.
Rotate tokens using the refresh cookie (CSRF-protected; revoked tokens rejected).
Clear cookies and revoke the refresh token.

get.description: Current user, active org, role, permissions and org list.

post.description: Re-issue the session for another org the user belongs to.

get.description: Current organisation.
Members of this org.

post.description: Add a member: attaches an existing user by email, or creates one (name + password required).

patch.description: Change a member's role / store scope (cannot demote the last owner).

delete.description: Remove a member (cannot remove the last owner).

get.description: Pending and used invites (never includes tokens).

post.description: Create a one-time invite link (7 days). No email is sent: share the link yourself.

get.description: What the invite page shows before accepting (valid token required).

post.description: Join the org. New email: creates the account. Existing email: the account's password must match.
Upload a CSV; returns suggested column mapping, preview rows and a validation report.

get.description: Re-run preview/validation for a stored upload with its saved mapping.

post.description: Validate and load the upload into sales_daily; 422 with a readable report if invalid.

get.description: Data-quality reports for this org, newest first.
#series, date range, % zero-sales days and latest quality score.

post.description: Onboarding: load a compact synthetic Indian retail dataset (6 stores x 100 SKUs, 2025) into an EMPTY org.

get.description: Inventory list; store managers only see their own locations.

post.description: Create a position (one per location+product).
Sell items atomically. Requires an Idempotency-Key header; replays return the original receipt.

get.description: Filterable audit trail for this org, newest first.

post.description: Queue a rolling-origin backtest (28-day folds). Runs in the worker; inline when INLINE_JOBS=true.

get.description: One job (progress / status / error / log tail).

post.description: Cancel a queued or running job. The status changes at once; a running backtest stops at its next checkpoint.

get.description: Recent jobs, newest first.
Model runs for this org, newest first.
Leaderboard: latest run per model, best WAPE first.
Recent history + each model's latest forecast band for one (location, product).
Counts used by dashboards: runs, forecast rows.

post.description: Make this run the champion for its scope; every other run of this org in that scope is demoted.

get.description: Order recommendations from the champion run (else the best-WAPE run) for every stocked, supplied product.

post.description: Create a draft PO. Quantities must respect the supplier's MOQ and pack size.

get.description: Purchase orders (newest first), with lines.
One purchase order with lines.

post.description: draft -> approved (owner/planner only).
approved -> sent; the ordered units become 'on order' at the location.
sent / partially_received -> partially_received or received; on_hand rises, on_order falls.
Cancel an open PO; units still 'on order' are released.
Baseline vs scenario for the scope; cached for 10 minutes per identical request.

get.description: Saved scenarios of this organisation, newest first.

post.description: Run and save a scenario (name, scope, changes and the result at the time).

get.description: TFT variable-selection weights + attention, or LightGBM SHAP, for one series.
Plain-language reason for the forecast; every number comes from stored data.
Which mode the copilot is in: 'llm' (tool-calling with a key) or 'rule-based' (no key needed).

post.description: Ask about this organisation's forecasts, risks, recommendations or models; answers cite their source.

get.description: Server-Sent Events for this organisation: sale, alert, job and sim events (cookie auth).
What a page needs to catch up after loading or reconnecting: totals, feed, alerts, stock watch, simulator.
Whether the simulator is available (demo tenant) and what it is doing right now.

post.description: Start the live store simulator. Needs forecasts (it follows them) and the demo tenant.
Ask the simulator to stop after the current tick.

get.description: All model versions with metrics, the champion history and MLflow links.
PSI on key features (training window vs new days) and live WAPE of the champion vs its backtest WAPE.

post.description: Run the same check the daily cron runs: an alert is published once per model version and starts a retrain.
Retrain every model of the latest runs now (same models and folds).

get.description: One series (Kaju Katli at Koramangala when present) from the synthetic demo tenant, for the landing page.
